verdict.rationale: Many published GitBook docs pages were retrieved at URLs ending in .md (e.g. gitbook-mcp.md, gitbook-cli.md, api-reference.md, custom-domain.md). That is direct evidence that appending .md to a page URL returns markdown. It is backed by a documented 'LLM-ready docs' page, an 'LLM optimizations' plan feature, and live llms.txt and llms-full.txt files. missing for 10: first-party documentation text explicitly describing the .md-suffix behavior and its coverage across all published pages (the pack has only the page title), an explanation of the 404 at the root /docs.md probe, and independent corroboration that the markdown output is clean.
